flags.message: The provisioned October 10 opposition asks at pages 3 and 29 to lift/terminate an administrative stay, but the October 11 snapshot contains no administrative-stay entry. This is a pre-decision record discrepancy, not discovery of this application's terminal disposition. I treated the stay as reported in advocacy only, retained the frozen not-yet-referred state, and did not count temporary administrative relief as the predicted substantive grant. Please check completeness of the provisioned proceedings.

The September 4, 2026 stay in related application 26A274, discussed in both provisioned briefs, is a major upward signal. It predates this event and is not the outcome being forecast. I did not seek or encounter the ultimate disposition of 26A477; the probability discounts the distinction between the earlier vacatur and the present mandamus order.
